content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to [product_name]. I'm currently working with a [product_name] device, specifically the [article_no] model. I want to find out if there's a way to read integer values from a data table stored on a PC and use those values in my program. After a certain delay, I need to fetch the next value from the same data table. Any suggestions on how to achieve this would be greatly appreciated. Thank you in advance.
Good morning [user_name], I personally haven't heard of this function being implemented with the [product_name] [article_no] model.

This feature is possible if you use an [product_name] Operator Panel Comfort and implement a script to read data from an Excel file on your PC. However, I'm unsure whether you can connect your [product_name] to the panel's Ethernet port.
Devices with Ethernet ports are only available in newer [product_name] models like [article_no]. [article_no] does not have Ethernet.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to solve how to transfer integer data from a PC table to a [product_name] [article_no] model. The consensus is that direct reading from a PC isn't supported on this model, and while workarounds using [product_name] Operator Panels exist, Ethernet connectivity is lacking on the [article_no] version, limiting possibilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to automate reading data tables directly from a PC into their [product_name] [article_no], including sequential value retrieval with delays.
